correctStatements.text: At 09:31 fatima.alhashimi reported that customers in Brazil were getting NXDOMAIN for the main domain.
Gregor found the domain was in a grace period because the renewal had failed.
chidi-okafor said the card on the registrar account had expired last month.
fatima.alhashimi estimated roughly 60% of resolvers had already dropped the cached records.
At 09:44 Gregor started paying the renewal with the corporate card.
At 09:50 Gregor got the renewal confirmed by the registrar.
At 09:55 brasilia-network-escalation-contact-primary asked the registrar to push the delegation immediately.
At 10:06 chidi-okafor saw the delegation on three public resolvers.
At 10:20 fatima.alhashimi saw Brazilian traffic recovering to 80% of normal.
At 10:40 fatima.alhashimi confirmed traffic was fully back to normal levels.
brasilia-network-escalation-contact-primary said the outage lasted about 49 minutes for most users.
Action item: enable auto-renew with two payment methods, owner chidi-okafor.
Action item: alert 45 days before any domain expires, owner Gregor.
